shortParaphrase: Son-line descendants at every level follow the stated descendant modes; a nearer male blocks lower levels, while a lower male can make females at his level and qualifying females above him residuaries.
conditions: Every intermediate link from the deceased to the represented descendant is a son.
Generation and sex of the final descendant are explicit.
The lower-male rescue applies to females above him only when they received none of the two-thirds entitlement.
exclusions: A path through a daughter is not a son-line descendant.
Females below the nearest eligible male generation remain blocked.
